Name: Cat To Fish
Author: smolmish
Description: turns the cats into super cucumber. To enable or disable super cucumber go into the "config" file and set whichever cat# you want to "true" or "false". Take care not to add extra spaces as this may affect the mod from working. Currently cat#4 and cat#5 cursor's still show the original cat sprite however they do still show up as super cucumbers in the game. This is a work in progress and will eventually be fixed.

Downloads.Description:
Turns cats to fish.
All cats are set to true by default unless changed in "config"
note: some cursors still show as cats but sprites show super cucumber in game, work in progress.
